testResults.name: api-revision-health
commands: az containerapp revision list --name fca-ml-dev-api --resource-group fca-rg-westus2
testResults.result: The active API revision fca-ml-dev-api--0000060 reports Healthy with 1 replica; startup, liveness, and readiness probes target the unauthenticated /health endpoint on port 8000

testResults.name: ingest-job-executions
commands: az containerapp job execution list --name fca-ml-dev-ingest --resource-group fca-rg-westus2
testResults.result: The scheduled execution fca-ml-dev-ingest-29806620 succeeded in 35 seconds at 2026-09-03T01:00:00Z and a manual execution succeeded at 2026-09-02T20:37:02Z; the three failed executions from 2026-09-02 predate the final image and configuration and have not recurred

testResults.name: managed-identity-wiring
commands: az containerapp job show --name fca-ml-dev-ingest --resource-group fca-rg-westus2
testResults.result: Both workloads use the user-assigned managed identity fca-ml-dev-runtime (principal 550d9d36-f59c-4af9-b228-71d1f51d0e9f, client 95caeb5c-e069-4c51-b97f-575ab481b0d6) with Main lifecycle identity settings and AZURE_CLIENT_ID runtime configuration; no passwords or connection strings are configured

testResults.name: storage-registry-and-vault-rbac
testResults.result: The runtime identity holds Storage Blob, Queue, and Table Data Contributor on fcaobj3kwwfxxfxu, AcrPull on fcau7enxjst4w72u, and Key Vault Secrets User on fca-ml-dev-kv-obj3kww; role assignments are scoped to the exact resources

testResults.name: key-vault-backed-secrets
testResults.result: The API resolves alpaca-api-key, alpaca-api-secret, and api-bearer-token and the ingest job resolves the two Alpaca secrets through identity-bound Key Vault references; secret values are never present in container configuration

testResults.name: budget-alert-contacts
testResults.result: The fca-ml-dev-budget-40usd and fca-ml-dev-budget-70usd resource-group budgets and the subscription SpendLimit budget notify Carson.Fricke@outlook.com; the earlier REPLACE_WITH_BUDGET_CONTACT_EMAIL placeholder is gone from the deployed budgets

testResults.name: no-connection-string-by-design
commands: az storage account show --name fcaobj3kwwfxxfxu --query allowSharedKeyAccess
probe of running API container via az containerapp exec
testResults.result: The storage account disables shared-key access and the ingest composition authenticates with DefaultAzureCredential(managed_identity_client_id=AZURE_CLIENT_ID), so the absence of AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING is the designed state, not a misconfiguration; the live /health probe returned 200 and the KV-backed bearer token authenticated successfully

limitations: The deployed API process currently composes in-memory catalog and job repositories because the production composition root does not yet consume the LAKE_* environment variables; this does not affect T047's managed-identity and health acceptance and is recorded as the blocker for T048
Container App ingress is internal-only, so hosted smoke checks were executed with az containerapp exec against localhost:8000
